summary: Supported AAP 2.6 upgrade paths: 2.4 RPM and Operator single-node to 2.6 growth, multi-node to 2.6 enterprise; 2.5 RPM, container and Operator growth/enterprise to the same 2.6 topology. RPM upgrade paths are deprecated and removed in 2.7.
questions: What upgrade paths are supported for AAP 2.6?
Can I upgrade 2.4 RPM multi node to 2.6?
Which 2.6 topology does a 2.4 single node upgrade to?

answer_card.title: AAP 2.6 upgrade paths
answer_card.answer_md:
| From | To |
|---|---|
| 2.4 RPM/Operator single node (controller, or controller+hub) | 2.6 growth (same type) |
| 2.4 RPM/Operator multi node (controller, or controller+hub) | 2.6 enterprise (same type) |
| 2.5 RPM / Container / Operator growth | 2.6 growth (same type) |
| 2.5 RPM / Container / Operator enterprise | 2.6 enterprise (same type) |

RPM upgrade paths are deprecated, removed in 2.7. 2.4 containerized is not an upgrade source.
